notes.title: No Time To Loot 2025 & Demo update
notes.content:
[h3]💎Do you like loot?[/h3][p][/p][p][i]Beyond the Map[/i] is part of [b]No Time To Loot 2025[/b] − the ultimate celebration of loot-driven gaming. From legendary treasures to chaotic randomized drops, this festival showcases the thrill of chasing rewards, upgrading gear, and diving headfirst into the madness of endless loot.[/p][p][/p][p]Running [b]September 22 – 29:
[/b][url="https://store.steampowered.com/developer/humanqube/sale/notimetolootfestival2025"]https://store.steampowered.com/developer/humanqube/sale/notimetolootfestival2025[/url][/p][p][/p][h3]🎮 Demo is up![/h3][p][/p][p]The demo has been updated to the latest patch and is available to play for a limited time during the event. Haven't tried the game yet? Jump in now![/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3587400"][/dynamiclink][i]All progress in the demo carries over into the full game.[/i][/p][p][/p][h3]📅 2025 Roadmap[/h3][p][/p][p][i]Beyond the Map[/i] has been out in Early Access for almost a month!
Thanks to everyone for playing and sharing feedback ❤️[/p][p][/p][p]The most requested [b]features[/b] − [i]controller support, map markers, difficulty settings, and others[/i] − are prioritized and will be added in small patches within the next three months.[/p][p][/p][p]As for the [b]content, [/b]the goal for this year remains unchanged − a big update with a new biome and dungeons is planned for Q4.[/p][p][/p][p]Full roadmap: [url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/2896380/discussions/0/707749927473701537/"]https://steamcommunity.com/app/2896380/discussions/0/707749927473701537/[/url][/p][h3]
🧪 Public-Test Branch[/h3][p][/p][p]Don't forget − all new features will land first on the [b]public-test [/b]branch.[/p][p]More info is available in the [i]#public-test[/i] channel on Discord: [url="https://discord.gg/dz4MzD2YUW"]https://discord.gg/dz4MzD2YUW[/url][/p]

notes.title: Patch Notes 0.2.4
notes.content:
[p][b]Bosses[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed a bug that caused bosses to deal excessive damage to player-built structures.[/p][/*][*][p]Drowned Cook's spinning bones now properly disappear when the encounter ends.[/p][/*][*][p]Skeleton Overlord now correctly uses all of his abilities.[/p][/*][*][p]Bosses now drop 2-3 legendary and 1-2 rare items.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Skills[/b][/p][list][*][p]New skill for mage builds: [b]Flame Shield[/b] (dropped by 2-star Drowned Mages).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Multi-Shot[/b]: Damage and on-hit multiplier reduced. New: each unique enemy hit increases the damage of the next Multi-Shot.
[i]Despite its name, Multi-Shot was most effective at short-range single-target damage and triggering on-hit effects. This change makes the skill more balanced and versatile.[/i][/p][/*][*][p]All arrows now fly for 1 second, reducing their maximum range from 32 to 20–24 units (depending on type).
[i]Still long enough for combat, but less likely to pull unwanted enemies with stray arrows.[/i][/p][/*][/list][p][b]Glyphs[/b][/p][list][*][p]Glyph of Turtle's Wisdom: Tension now also reduces damage taken.[/p][/*][*][p]Bear Might: redesigned for melee builds.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Items[/b][/p][list][*][p]You can now [b]compare items[/b] (hold Left Shift).
[i]Note: this system currently doesn't do a good job of comparing weapons.[/i][/p][/*][*][p]Set bonuses no longer require items to be upgraded.[/p][/*][*][p]Legendary rings now empower specific glyphs.[/p][/*][*][p]First [b]skill-specific legendary affix[/b]: Suppressive Fire (can roll on medium armor). Increases the number of arrows fired by Multi-Shot.[/p][/*][*][p]All cloaks now increase maximum health when upgraded to [b]Legendary[/b] quality. Already-upgraded cloaks automatically gain this effect.[/p][/*][*][p]Amplification effect reduced, but now also applies to the rare (blue) affix on the item.[/p][/*][*][p]Legendary affix Mortal Wounds is now correctly treated as a kill, granting experience and triggering on-kill effects.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Enemies[/b][/p][list][*][p]Reduced damage scaling for higher-level enemies.[/p][/*][*][p]Enemy climbing abilities now roughly match the player's.[/p][/*][*][p]Summoned enemies no longer drop loot or grant experience.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that caused enemies to always grant full experience regardless of level difference. Experience is now properly scaled down, reaching 0 when the difference is 10 levels or more (indicated by a gray number on the nameplate).[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Misc[/b][/p][list][*][p]Spellforge now offers [b]new enchants[/b] for Chest, Cloak, and Rings.[/p][/*][*][p]Packing Table now correctly increases maximum stack size in the Stash by 50% (additive on top of the default 200%).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Rain decay[/b] reduced.[/p][/*][*][p]Excess critical chance is no longer converted into critical damage.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that caused basic attacks to restore health or mana multiple times per attack.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Stash[/b] now has a [b]sort[/b] button. Sorting and stacking are now limited to the current page.[/p][/*][*][p]Whiteshard Salt now properly increases Soup duration.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that caused equipped items dropped on death to expire.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that caused Agility to increase Wand damage.
[i]Side note: Intellect has never increased Wand damage - neither before this patch nor after.[/i][/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes 0.2.3
notes.content:
[p][b]General[/b][/p][list][*][p]New movement system should completely prevent clipping with both mouse and keyboard movement.
[i]As a side effect, you can now drop off ledges. Climbing up will be added in a future update.[/i][/p][/*][*][p]All worlds now include 2 additional snowy islands with high-level skeletons, making it easier to farm high-level items.
[i]These islands will remain until Q4 2025, when dungeons arrive and become the main source of high-level gear.[/i][/p][/*][/list][p][b]Skills[/b][/p][list][*][p]Roll cooldown reduced to 6 seconds, with Agility now having a smaller effect on reducing it further.[/p][/*][*][p]Void Orb now correctly deals 100% SP damage per second (was 20%).[/p][/*][*][p]New melee-focused skill: [b]Charge[/b], dropped by 1+ star Drowned Warriors.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Items[/b][/p][list][*][p]Newly crafted and looted boots will always roll with movement speed.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced stat scaling for higher-level items.[/p][/*][*][p]Rare affixes "+8–12% Strength/Agility/Intellect" replaced with bonus damage to specific skills (Charge, Rapid Fire, Void Orb).[/p][/*][*][p]All weapons now properly receive their intended legendary affixes instead of random ones.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Misc[/b][/p][list][*][p]Improved performance when loading a world and moving through areas with many trees or built objects.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that could cause crashes when approaching certain locations or when loading a world.[/p][/*][*][p]Wooden arrows removed; other arrows are now crafted in stacks of 50 and require fewer resources.[/p][/*][*][p]Turtle's Wisdom now stacks to 50, increasing damage by 1% per stack. The chance to gain a stack of Tension increased to 150%.[/p][/*][*][p]Scholar's Portal no longer disappears randomly.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][b]Sep 8 Hotfixes[/b] [/p][list][*][p]Terrain cliffs are smoother now, with fewer spots where you can get stuck.,[/p][/*][*][p]If you do get stuck, there's now an Unstuck option in the pause menu, which resets your respawn point and kills your character.,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that caused the default respawn point to be slightly below the terrain, often leading to respawning in the water beneath it.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes 0.2.2
notes.content:
[p][b]Base Building[/b][/p][list][*][p]You should no longer clip through the floor.
[i]Known issues: this may still happen when spawning or when building over deep water.[/i][/p][/*][*][p]Base structures now have better resistance to higher-level enemy attacks.[/p][/*][*][p]Sharp Stakes now deal 100% of the damage they take back to enemies attacking them in melee range (was a fixed amount).[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that caused base structures to be vulnerable to Arcane damage (most importantly, Ghost explosions).[/p][/*][*][p]Storage Boxes can now be placed under Packing Tables.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Bugs[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed a bug that caused enemies to camp endlessly at the player's death spot.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that caused +Slash and +Pierce damage affixes to incorrectly increase Fire damage.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that caused wands to consume arrows.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that caused save file corruption if the game was closed during world loading.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Misc[/b][/p][list][*][p]Raft no longer requires a rope and now sails 20% faster.[/p][/*][*][p]Enemies no longer attack portals.[/p][/*][*][p]World loading is now faster.[/p][/*][*][p]Bosses no longer follow players into the ocean.[/p][/*][*][p]Nighttime raiders can no longer have more than 1 star (and the strongest of them can't have any).[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes 0.2.1 & 0.2.2
notes.content:
[p]While big updates are still being worked on, this patch addresses the most important issues players reported within the first two days after launch.

[b]General[/b][/p][list][*][p]New option: Friendly Fire ([b]off[/b] by default) - allows damage to player-built objects.[/p][/*][*][p]Night spawns are now less frequent, contain fewer enemies, and can no longer incorrectly spawn inside player bases.[/p][/*][*][p]Teleporting now grants an aura that makes enemies ignore you for 10 seconds or until you attack.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]World[/b][/p][p][i]Some issues with world generation caused entities to be missing or to never respawn.[/i][/p][p][i]⚠️Unfortunately, these fixes only apply to newly created worlds:[/i][/p][list][*][p]Islands are now larger and should always contain the intended content (specifically Ghosts).[/p][/*][*][p]Most enemies now respawn properly within 2-4 in-game days.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where islands ignored the world seed, which caused different layouts of POIs with the same seed.[/p][/*][/list][p][i]Note: you can play the same character across multiple worlds.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]Transmutation[/b][/p][p][i]Originally planned as part of Alchemy (which didn't make it into launch).[/i][/p][p][i]For now, 3 new recipes are available at the Spellforge:[/i][/p][list][*][p]Linen to Copper[/p][/*][*][p]Linen to Tin[/p][/*][*][p]Silk to Iron[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Misc[/b][/p][p][i]Some of these fixes had already been implemented earlier but were not documented:[/i][/p][list][*][p]Skeletons now drop more Silk.[/p][/*][*][p]Bosses can no longer be frozen.[/p][/*][*][p]Ironhead Arrows now correctly appear at the Workbench after discovering Iron Bars.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed several localization issues where text was missing or incorrect.[/p][/*][*][p]Freezing damage reduced from 10% to 5% health per second, and now starts closer to the coast.[/p][/*][*][p]Silver Lockboxes now contain 2-3 Silver (was 1-2).[/p][/*][*][p]Enemies no longer chase players into the deep ocean.[/p][/*][*][p]Ghosts now have a higher chance to drop Ghostweave.[/p][/*][*][p]Drowned Cook's Enrage now lasts 5 seconds and no longer stacks (still dispellable with bone piles).[/p][/*][/list][p]
[b]Next patch:[/b]
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2896380/view/518597293118587434?l=english"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Patch notes 0.1.6
notes.content:
[h3]Patch notes 0.1.6[/h3]

[i]Including changes from 0.1.4[/i]

[b]Worlds[/b]
[list]
[*] Added [u]new world modifier[/u] that spawns additional enemies at night.
[*] Newly created demo islands now feature rivers and more varied terrain.
[*] Added rainy weather. [i]Have you already built your roofs?[/i][/list]
[b]Crafting[/b]
[list]
[*] Added new [u]Bronze tools[/u].
[*] Added Sharpening Wheel for restoring durability to metal tools. [/list]
[b]Misc[/b]
[list]
[*] Reduced all Trait cooldowns from 20 to 15 minutes.[/list]
[b]Buildings[/b]
[list]
[*] [u]Building snapping[/u] is now available!
[*] Buildings now require connection to the terrain, or they will collapse.
[*] Added 3 Thatch Roof pieces.[/list]
[b]Notable bugs[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that caused arrows to disappear without dealing damage.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused items to lose extra stacked amounts in Stash.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused Cooldown Reduction to have a very diminished effect.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused keybinds to reset to default values on exit.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused some items dropped on death to disappear on chunk unload.[/list]

notes.title: Patch notes 0.1.2
notes.content:
[h3]Patch Notes 0.1.2[/h3]

[b]Buildings[/b]
- Single 10-slot chest added.
- Stash now has tabs.
- You can now build Portals.
- Cauldron now requires 3 ingredients (but can still use 4).

[b]Controls[/b]
- WASD movement can now be enabled in Options.
- You no longer have to click repeatedly to keep interacting with the same breakable object.

[b]Crafting and Items[/b]
- Crafted armor sets now have new bonuses.
- Crafted items can now be upgraded to Rare and then Legendary quality.
[i]Note: Weapons are still WIP and are not very consistent with what affixes they receive.[/i]

[b]Skills[/b]
- New build customization system is available: Skill Board.

[b]Worlds[/b]
- Equipment is no longer dropped on death by default, it's now a world modifier, which increases all experience gained by 30%.

[b]UI[/b]
- Map can now be zoomed and moved.
- Pause menu now actually pauses the game.
- Inventory can now be sorted.
- Charcoal and metal bars can now be mass queued.
- Items dropped on death now remember their inventory and equipment slots.
- Camera can now be rotated (Alt+RMB by default).
- Pirates can now remove ?s from their maps!

Less impactful changes and bug fixes are not mentioned here. Check them out in game!

notes.title: March 29-31 Hotfixes
notes.content:
[i]Due to issues with enemy AI and respawning, the game turned out a bit more brutal than intended. We're proud of everyone who could withstand the onslaught of elite boars and wolves, but here are the fixes:[/i]

[b]March 29 #1[/b]

[list]
[*]Fixed a bug that caused enemies to respawn inside the player base.
[*]Fixed a bug that caused enemies to attack structures built by players while they were away.
[*]Fixed a bug that caused Sharp Stakes to have no collision.
[*]Fixed a bug that allowed enemies to open Gates.
[*]Fixed a bug that caused Campfires and Cauldrons to consume the whole stack but produce only 1 food.
[*]Reduced enemy baseline aggro range and sight angle.
[*]Map markers can now be removed with a right click.
[/list]

[b]March 29 #2[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug that caused items to disappear from an upgraded Stash upon loading a world.
[*]Fixed a bug that caused enemies not to return to their spawn after killing the player.
[/list]

[b]March 30[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug that caused certain items to render a glitched line across the screen.  
[*]Fixed a bug that caused players to become stuck in Incinerate cast until out of mana.  
[/list]

[b]March 31[/b]
[list]
[*]Enemies now stop chasing the player if no damage is dealt or taken for a while.
[*]Common items can now be disenchanted (mainly for disposal, but with a small chance to yield Mana Dust).
[*]Stash now has 200% max stack capacity by default and can be further increased with the new Packing Table upgrade.
[/list]

[i]Note: There are other minor changes not mentioned here.
Note: Restart Steam to force an update check.[/i]
